source.text: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹתהִנֵּ֤ה׀בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הָעֹמְדִ֥ים בְּבֵית־יְ֝הוָ֗ה בַּלֵּילֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: The song of the ascents. Look, bless YHWH, all servants of YHWH, who stand in [the] house of YHWH in the nights.

en.L: A song of ascents. Look, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all [you] servants of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who stand in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the nights.
en.B: A song of ascents. Now bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, every servant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who stands night after night in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem. All you servants of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who serve in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s house at night, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Cantique des montées. Voici, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, esclaves {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui vous tenez dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pendant les nuits.
fr.B: Cantique des montées. Allons, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous, serviteurs {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui vous tenez nuit après nuit dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Chant pour la montée vers Jérusalem. Vous tous, serviteurs {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qui servez la nuit dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

decisions.reason: As in 120:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1, so the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a song of ascents: probably a pilgrim song
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one of the fifteen songs probably sung by pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: servants who stand: priests and Levites on duty
decisions.reason: To "stand" before the LORD is to serve him. Levites served in the temple by night as well as by day (1 Chronicles 9:33; 23:30). The last Song of Ascents calls them to bless the LORD.
When people bless (barak) the LORD, they praise him and thank him for what he is and does (124:6).

decisions.choice: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem

decisions.reason: Readable says "praise" for blessing the LORD, as in 124:6.

decisions.choice: "esclaves du SEIGNEUR" (Literal), "serviteurs du SEIGNEUR" (Balanced, Readable) for ʿavdei YHWH
decisions.reason: As the French terms set for ʿeved in Psalms: "esclave" at Literal, "serviteur" at Balanced and Readable. At Literal the word shows that the Hebrew uses the same word for a slave and for one who serves God; here they are the priests and Levites on duty, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "louez" at Readable for "bless the LORD"; "bénissez" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: To bless the LORD is to praise him, as the meaning decision says; Readable uses the plainer word, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: Lift up your hands [to the] holy place and bless YHWH.

en.L: Lift up your hands [to the] holy place and bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Raise your hands toward the sanctuary, and bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Lift your hands in prayer toward the holy place and praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Levez vos mains [vers le] lieu saint et bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Levez les mains vers le sanctuaire et bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Levez les mains pour prier, tournés vers le lieu saint, et louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

decisions.choice: lifting hands: the posture of prayer and praise
decisions.reason: People prayed and praised with raised hands, often toward the holy place of the temple (28:2; 63:5; 1 Kings 8:22).
The word (qodesh) without a preposition is probably "toward the holy place"; it has also been read "in holiness".

source.text: יְבָרֶכְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מִצִּיּ֑וֹן עֹ֝שֵׂ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: May YHWH bless you from Zion, maker of heaven and earth.

en.L: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you from Zion, maker of heaven and earth.
en.B: From Zion may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the one who made heaven and earth, bless you.
en.R: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who made heaven and earth, bless you from Zion!

fr.L: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bénisse depuis Sion, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui a fait le ciel et la terre !
fr.B: Que de Sion {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, celui qui a fait le ciel et la terre, te bénisse !
fr.R: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui a fait le ciel et la terre, te bénisse depuis Sion !

decisions.reason: "You" is singular. The servants in the temple seem to answer with a blessing on each worshiper, in the words of the priestly blessing (Numbers 6:24: "May the LORD bless you"). Those who bless the LORD (verses 1-2) are blessed by him.

decisions.choice: maker of heaven and earth: the creator of all
decisions.reason: As in 121:2, a title naming the LORD as the creator of everything; it also closes 134:3.

decisions.choice: from Zion: the end of the pilgrim songs
decisions.reason: The Songs of Ascents end with a blessing from Zion (128:5), sending the pilgrim home with the LORD's blessing.
